label: a1 being (re)chosen after an unrewarded rare previous trial (D1, and D2 on reaching S1)
explanation: Fires only on non-GO steps of a trial that follows an UNREWARDED trial (prev_reward==0 carries 100% of mass; never after reward) and in which the agent chooses a1 (action==1 carries 100% of mass, essentially never a2). At D2 it needs the reached state S1 (a1 to S1 common). So the hard envelope is (prev_reward==0)&(action==1)&(phase!=GO): recall 1.00 but precision 0.28. Inside it, activity is strongly enriched when the previous trial was RARE (prev_common==0, lift 3.2x, 72% of mass), i.e. the model-based stay after rare-unrewarded a1 (a1 to S2, no reward), so the agent repeats a1. It is also enriched when the policy logit is moderately pro-a1 (choice 2.8 to 8.1: 94% of mass, versus none for strongly pro-a1 >8.1). It also rises with trial index in the episode (silent in trials 0-9, peaks around trials 50-80). D2 activations are larger and more frequent (61% of mass) than D1 ones. Silent at GO, after rewarded trials, when choosing a2, and at D2 in S2. The recorded predicate uses action at D1, which is marked FUTURE but is the agent own upcoming choice (legitimate); at D2 it uses only observed inputs. Misses are mostly a1 trials after a common-unrewarded trial; false positives are rare-unrewarded a1 trials where the unit stays quiet, so precision is about 0.49 and dev F1 about 0.57.
